user.title: zigbee-rs hub
user.description: Address of the hub's WebSocket API (`ws://<host>:<port>/api`). The API token is shown by the hub console command `token`.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the hub.
data_description.port: HTTP port of the hub (80 on the ESP32-S3 hub, 8099 for `hubctl serve`).

reauth_confirm.title: Authenticate again
reauth_confirm.description: The hub at {host} refused the API token. Enter the current token (hub console: `token`).

reconfigure.title: zigbee-rs hub
reconfigure.description: New address or token of the hub.

abort.wrong_hub: This address belongs to a different hub (another coordinator IEEE).

data.sync_time_zone: Sync the hub time zone from Home Assistant

data_description.sync_time_zone: Set the hub's time zone (its Time cluster and the Tuya time sync for devices, its automations' schedules) to Home Assistant's, now, on every connection and when Home Assistant's changes.

unknown_device.message: Device {device_id} is not a device of a loaded zigbee-rs hub.

no_catalog.message: No loaded zigbee-rs hub has a definitions catalog.

one_hub.message: More than one zigbee-rs hub is loaded: pick one.

permit_join.name: Permit join
permit_join.description: Opens the Zigbee network for new devices.

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: The hub; all hubs when empty.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds the network stays open (0 closes it).

include_gp.name: Green Power
include_gp.description: Also open the Green Power commissioning window.

device_id.name: Router
device_id.description: Only this router accepts joins; the whole network when empty.

reinterview_device.name: Re-interview device
reinterview_device.description: Reads the device's descriptors and Basic attributes again and re-resolves its entities.

reconfigure_device.name: Reconfigure device
reconfigure_device.description: Repeats binds and reporting configuration of the device.

update_catalog.name: Update definitions catalog
update_catalog.description: Downloads the signed definitions catalog from the hub's mirror, uploads a newer bank and web tools to the hub, and fetches definitions for devices that resolve to generic entities only.

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: The hub; all hubs when empty.

force.name: Force
force.description: Install the bank even if the hub's anti-rollback check refuses it.

base_url.name: Mirror URL
base_url.description: The catalog mirror for this run instead of the one set on the hub (base URL of a release, e.g. …/latest).

import_from_zha.name: Import from ZHA
import_from_zha.description: Moves ZHA's network and devices to the hub without pairing them again: reads ZHA's zigbee.db, its newest network backup and the names and areas of its devices. Without apply it only previews. Applying needs the ZHA integration disabled first (two coordinators must never run one network).

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: The hub (needed with more than one).

database.name: Database
database.description: ZHA's database file; zigbee.db in the configuration directory when empty.

backup.name: Backup file
backup.description: A ZHA network backup (Configure → Download backup) instead of the newest one in the database.

force.name: Replace the running network
force.description: The hub's radio runs another network: replace it (it is backed up first).

confirm.name: Re-tag records
confirm.description: The hub's device registry holds another network's records: re-tag them as the imported network's.

confirm_ieee_write_once.name: Write the coordinator IEEE once
confirm_ieee_write_once.description: EmberZNet radios: write ZHA's coordinator IEEE to the one-time token (irreversible).

keep_ieee.name: Keep this radio's IEEE
keep_ieee.description: Do not take ZHA's coordinator IEEE: the devices are configured again.

skip_backup.name: Skip the backup
skip_backup.description: Do not back up the network the import replaces.

remove_missing.name: Remove other devices
remove_missing.description: Remove the hub's devices that are not in ZHA.

reconfigure.name: Configure again
reconfigure.description: auto: when the coordinator IEEE changed; always; never.

copy_names_areas.name: Copy names and areas
copy_names_areas.description: Gives the hub's devices the names you set and the areas of the same devices in ZHA or Zigbee2MQTT (after an import from the web UI or hubctl).

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: The hub (needed with more than one).

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Also where the hub's device has a name or an area already.
